## Role in the System

`nflendzonePipeline` is the production ETL + feature factory. It ingests raw `nflverse` datasets, computes derived football/modeling features, and publishes versioned release artifacts to `nflendzoneData`.

## Execution Entry Points

| Script | Purpose | Key outputs |
|---|---|---|
| `data-raw/update_all_data.R` | main ETL orchestration (full/incremental) | `nfl_stats_*`, standings, ratings, features, model tables |
| `data-raw/update_team_strength_model.R` | run Stan workflow via `nflendzoneModel` and upload model outputs | `team_strength_*`, `result_*`, `league_hfa_*`, `team_strength_fit`, `team_strength_gq` |
| `data-raw/update_historic_odds_data.R` | odds/event snapshot ingestion from The Odds API | `historic_events` (and related odds pathways) |

## Data Products Built in `update_all_data.R`

### Source-layer

- `game_data`, `game_data_long`
- `pbp_data`
- `nfl_stats_week_team_regpost`, `nfl_stats_week_player_regpost`
- `nfl_stats_season_team_regpost`, `nfl_stats_season_player_regpost`

### Derived football metrics

- `season_standings`, `weekly_standings`
- `elo`, `srs`, `epa`
- `scores`, `series`, `turnover`, `redzone`

### Modeling tables

- `team_features`
- `game_features`
- `team_model`
- `game_model`

## Core Function Families (`R/`)

| Family | Notable functions |
|---|---|
| Data loaders/prep | `compute_game_data()`, `compute_game_data_long()`, `compute_pbp_data()` |
| Ratings/standings | `compute_elo_data()`, `compute_srs_data()`, `compute_season_standings_data()`, `compute_weekly_standings_data()` |
| Feature builders | `compute_epa_data()`, `compute_scores_data()`, `compute_series_data()`, `compute_turnover_data()`, `compute_redzone_data()` |
| Modeling tables | `compute_team_features_data()`, `compute_team_model_data()`, `compute_game_model_data()` |
| Release publishing | `save_and_upload()`, `upload_model_output()`, `upload_cmdstan_outputs()` |
| Infra helpers | `should_rebuild()`, `add_nflverse_ids()`, `add_week_seq()`, `add_flexible_net_features()` |

## Release/File Convention

For each release tag, the pipeline writes:

- archive files (`tag.rds`, optionally `tag.parquet`, `tag.csv`)
- timestamp sidecars (`timestamp.txt`, `timestamp.json`)
- season partitions (`tag_<season>.rds/.parquet/.csv` when applicable)

Model-side uploads follow week-specific naming:

- `tag_<season>_<week>.rds`
- `tag_timestamp.rds`
- `tag_timestamp.json`

## Automation

- `.github/workflows/update_data.yml`
- `.github/workflows/update_team_strength_model.yml`
- `.github/workflows/update_README.yml`

These workflows separate ETL refresh, Bayesian model refresh, and README report regeneration.

## What Ignore Files Tell You

### `.gitignore`

- local session/IDE state excluded (`.Rproj.user`, `.Rhistory`, `.RData`, `.vscode`)
- Quarto intermediates excluded (`.quarto`, `**/*.quarto_ipynb`)
- `artifacts/model-archive/` excluded from git tracking
- `artifacts/data-archive/` intentionally tracked (pipeline state + reproducible local cache)

### `.Rbuildignore`

- excludes package-dev assets (`README.Rmd`, `README.qmd`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`)
- excludes `artifacts` and rendered vignette intermediates from package bundles

This split indicates the repo serves two purposes:

1. as an R package with reusable compute functions
2. as an operational ETL orchestration repo with tracked local archive state

## Integration Notes

- Upstream: `nflverse` packages + optional The Odds API.
- Downstream: release assets consumed by `nflendzoneData`, `nflendzoneModel`, and `nflendzoneApp`.
- This repo is the system source of truth for feature table definitions and naming contracts.
